name: Locomoco
source: Loсomoсo is a girl who can transform into a bunny, what, according to her, saves her energy. This is not surprising considering that she always travels sitting on the Prir's hands. While in human form, she has great physical strength. And when her life is threatened, she goes berserk and can single-handedly beat even a dragon. Loco terribly loves the tea and sweets. She is the life and soul of the company, and thanks to her tea party sessions, our heroes can easily forget all the disputes and enjoy the peaceful atmosphere. However, she often says what she thinks, which is why she often becomes a punching bag for some enraged characters. Locomoco had her own reasons to join Caro's group, which she, of course, won't tell anyone.
